question: VP Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan were honoured with Rukminidevi Memorial Award in 2009 for which of the following Indian classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• VP Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan are renowned Bharatanatyam dancers and choreographers from Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• They were honored with the Rukminidevi Memorial Award in 2009 for their significant contributions to the art form of Bharatanatyam.
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance traditions in India, originating from the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• The Rukminidevi Memorial Award is named after Rukmini Devi Arundale, who is credited with reviving and popularizing Bharatanatyam in the 20th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam:**

 
 
• It is a classical Indian dance form that combines expression (Bhava), melody (Raga), rhythm (Tala), and dance (Natyam).
 
• Originally performed exclusively in Hindu temples by Devadasis, it later evolved into a widely practiced and respected art form.
 
• The dance is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate footwork, expressive hand gestures (mudras), and facial expressions.
 
 
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale:**
 
 
• She was an Indian theosophist, dancer, and choreographer who played a pivotal role in revitalizing Bharatanatyam.
 
• She founded the Kalakshetra Foundation in Chennai, an academy dedicated to the preservation and teaching of Bharatanatyam and other traditional arts.
 
• Rukmini Devi was instrumental in removing the dance from its association with temple rituals and giving it a new cultural and educational context.
 
 
 
• **Kalakshetra Foundation:**
 
 
• Established in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale, it is an arts and cultural academy dedicated to the preservation of traditional values in Indian art and crafts.
 
• The foundation is renowned for its dance-drama productions, which have set high standards in the field of Bharatanatyam.
 
• Kalakshetra also focuses on music, visual arts, textile design, and other traditional Indian crafts.
